links.outcome: Time to diagnosis, anticoagulation, intervention and in-hospital mortality, pre-AI vs post-AI cohorts
links.effect: Time to diagnosis 72.5 to 40 min (P=.00005); intervention 1360 to 1224 min (P=.036); anticoagulation 76 vs 61.5 min (P=.824); two deaths, both pre-AI; underpowered for mortality.
links.quote: Time to diagnosis improved significantly from 72.5 (IQR, 44.5-93.3) to 40 (IQR, 28-68.2) minutes (P = .00005).

screen.reason: Evaluates the clinical and workflow impact of deploying an FDA-cleared AI triage tool (Viz.ai PE) in clinical practice, comparing pre- and post-implementation eras.
